about: THE BUILD'S GRAPH (kb/Work PB5207, PB5218, PB5231; scripts/buildgraph.py). Each target has a KIND: a `test` target is a test assembly, which records a PASS; a `generated` target is a Python command that writes declared OUTPUTS into a directory of the worktree's own and records their DIGEST. Each declares its INPUTS (path patterns, each naming its reader), its exclusions (each naming why), the FACETS its key covers (all of `facets` unless it names fewer) and the targets it DEPENDS on. A target's key is a digest of its facets, the OUTPUT DIGEST of each dependency (never the dependency's inputs) and the git blob ids of the tracked paths its inputs match, less its exclusions; its record is stored once per target and key in the one store every worktree shares. An input missed here is a FALSE GREEN: the BUILD TARGETS audit (`python scripts/buildgraph.py check`) fails when a test source of an assembly names a repository path outside its target's inputs, and every run of a generated target is traced and refused when it reads outside its inputs.

build.about: What building a test assembly and the compiler it tests reads, shared by every test target ('@build').

inputs.src/: every product project (the compiler, the runtime, the CLI the suites drive)
inputs.Directory.Build.props: the root props every project imports
inputs..gitattributes: the checkout's bytes of every file a test reads
inputs.toolchain.env: the tool versions (also the toolchain facet)
inputs.tests/Directory.Build.props: the test-tree props: links tests/_shared/*.cs and the weights into every test project
inputs.tests/_shared/: linked into every test project (TestRepo, SuiteManifest, the gate framework, the weights)

conformance-suite.about: The conformance suite's manifests: conformance-suite/harness/generate.py, the one reader of the test headers, writes <edition>/manifest.json and wiseowl/manifest.json. It refuses a test that names a rule the inventory lacks, so the inventory is ITS input; conformance depends on its OUTPUT, so a records-only change that leaves the manifests byte-identical leaves conformance up to date (kb/Work PB5231). The inputs were derived by reading the generator and by a traced run of `generate.py --out` (kb/Work PB5218, PB5231), and every gate's run of it is traced again.

outputs.wiseowl/manifest.json: every test of both trees at each edition it names, and WiseOwl's refusals (SuiteManifest)
outputs.*/manifest.json: each edition's suite, which harness/run.py runs (RunPyHarness)

inputs.conformance-suite/: the generator and the modules it imports (harness/generate.py, config.py, cobol_source.py), every test's header and expected outputs (cases/, wiseowl/cases/), WiseOwl's refusals and compile options (wiseowl/diagnostics/, wiseowl/options/), the adapters, profiles and baselines it checks, and implementor-defined.json (traced)
inputs.tests/version-matrix/: the traceability inventory of both editions (inventory/, inventory-1985/), inventory-schema.json, the construct catalogue (constructs/), reserved-words.json, annex-a2-undefined.json and conformance-register.json (traced), and the files the schema names
inputs.scripts/spec/: imported: construct_store, generated_output, inventory_schema, inventory_store, inventory_view, lineage (traced); the directory is on the module path ahead of the standard library, so a file added there can shadow a module it imports
inputs.scripts/live_tools.py: imported by scripts/standard_streams.py when it lists the live tools
inputs..gitattributes: the checkout's bytes of every file it reads
